gaps.explanation: The governmental funds statement (Statement of Assets and Fund Balances and Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds, pp6-9, printed pp10-13) prints four fund columns: General, Street, TIF and Bond Fund (Total Governmental Funds receipts 3,957,315.13, p7). Detail comes from the budget schedules (pp11-12, printed pp29/31), which have only General 3,737,655.71, Street 108,700.22 and TIF 56,084.27 = 3,902,440.20. The Bond Fund (Debt Service Fund, p14 'Bond Funds' receipts 54,874.93) has no schedule. Its p7 (printed p11) column: Property Tax 46,295.83 + In-Lieu-of Tax 3,289.81 + Property Tax Credit 3,578.96 + Homestead Exemption 1,339.62 + Motor Vehicle Prorate 207.84 + Interest 162.87 = 54,874.93 (printed Bond Fund Total Receipts). 3,902,440.20 + 54,874.93 = 3,957,315.13 = statement total.
